# Konta

> Konta is an online accounting program for companies and accounting firms in the Republic of Moldova, made by December Capital. It is still in development: the demo at demo.konta.md is open to anyone, and Konta cannot be bought yet. Tax rates, thresholds, deadlines and accounts are not written into its code; it reads them from a public rulebook in which every value carries the date it applies from and the act it comes from.

Everything here is as of 1 November 2026 and says what the site's own pages say. The rulebook's values are still being checked by a licensed accountant and are marked "unverified" until they are. Konta has no published prices yet, and no ratings or reviews.

## Pages

Romanian at the addresses below; Russian under /ru/ and English under /en/ (for example https://konta.md/en/calendar/).

- [Home](https://konta.md/): what Konta is, and what works today in the demo
- [Tax calendar](https://konta.md/calendar/): filing and payment deadlines, non-working days and changes in the law, each with its act and article, generated from the rulebook; .ics feeds per kind of taxpayer and an RSS of changes in the law
- [Salary calculator 2026](https://konta.md/calculator-salariu/): one month's salary from gross to net and the employer's cost, every figure from the rulebook; it passes the same payroll test cases as Konta's own payroll, from one public file
- [User guide](https://konta.md/ghid/): for accountants, step by step: the e-Factura API user, opening balances from 1C, the first month, closing the month, importing a bank statement
- [Ten questions for any accounting software vendor](https://konta.md/intrebari/): with Konta's own answers, each marked today, in part or planned
- [Security](https://konta.md/securitate/): what is done, what comes before the first pilot client, what comes later
- [e-Factura](https://konta.md/e-factura/): what works with e-Factura today, what comes next, and what the law requires now
- [Moving from 1C](https://konta.md/trecerea-de-la-1c/): the first company moved by Konta, free, then both programs side by side until the sums match; why no programmer is needed, since rates, thresholds and deadlines are data Konta updates once for every client, and what changes in 2027
- [Partners](https://konta.md/parteneri/): accounting firms invited to build Konta with its makers
- [Transparency](https://konta.md/transparenta/), [Privacy](https://konta.md/privacy/), [Contact](https://konta.md/contact/)

## Public repositories

- [konta-rulebook](https://github.com/December-Capital/konta-rulebook): Moldovan fiscal law as effective-dated data with its sources: the 2026 and 2027 rule sets, the general chart of accounts, the deadline calendar with holidays and changes in the law, e-Factura's classifiers, and the payroll test cases the salary calculator and the product both pass. The rule sets and the chart of accounts are licensed CC BY 4.0.
- [konta-efactura](https://github.com/December-Capital/konta-efactura): a .NET client for the State Tax Service's e-Factura SOAP API, generated from its WSDL.

The application itself is not open source.

## Works today, in the demo

In the demo you can start from Exemplu SRL, an invented company with a year of data, or from your own company.

- The general chart of accounts (Ministry of Finance Order 119/2013), with the company's own subaccounts
- The journal of entries, corrected only by reversal
- The trial balance, account statement, general ledger and memorial orders, on screen, printed and in Excel
- Sales invoices, numbered without gaps, and purchase invoices, in lei or in a foreign currency at BNM's rate
- Acts of completed works, with their invoice or on their own, paid like an invoice, and several partial acts for one invoice
- Proforma invoices, kept outside the books, made on request into a draft sales invoice that names them
- The sales and purchase VAT registers
- Bank receipts and payments, advances included, settling the partner's invoices and acts, and the partner statement
- The cash desk: receipt and payment orders and the cash book, never below zero
- Bank statements from a file (MT940 or a table), as payments the accountant checks and posts; each bank's own format waits on real statements
- Currency bought and sold at the bank's rate, exchange differences, and the month-end revaluation of balances in a currency at BNM's rate
- Short-term credits and loans (511, 512), with interest accrued by the day and instalments split into principal and interest
- Prepaid expenses: a purchase invoice line on account 261 is spread month by month to the expense account chosen
- Share capital: the associates, the capital subscribed and paid in, in money or in kind, and what each still owes
- Fixed assets: monthly depreciation (straight line, diminishing balance or units of production) with tax depreciation beside it, revaluation, impairment, sale and write-off
- Stock by warehouse (accounts 211 and 217) at weighted average cost: receipts from purchase invoices, sales, issues, transfers and stocktakes; nothing leaves that is not there
- Payroll by the cumulative method of Government Decision 697/2014: timesheets, leave, sick days paid by the employer, the payslip, a raise from mid-month by working days, and compensation for unused leave when someone leaves
- Closing the month step by step (depreciation, payroll, the VAT statement, interest, prepaid expenses), with the registers checked against their accounts; reopening needs a reason and stays in the audit log
- Closing the year: income and expenses into 351, the result into 333
- Opening balances from a 1C trial balance, by partner too (.xlsx, .csv or pasted from Excel)
- Accounting firms work in client companies through a mandate, with a role for each person, and see every client on one screen: deadlines, unresolved statement lines, missing details
- Each company's filing and payment deadlines from the rulebook, each with an owner and a status
- Customer and supplier details looked up at SFS by IDNO (its test service for now), filled in only if the user picks them
- The e-Factura screen: the company's issued and received invoices, read with its own API user (from SFS's test service for now); a received invoice becomes a draft purchase invoice
- Full export of a company's data, with the original files
- Printing a sales invoice, acts, cash orders and payslips, or saving them as PDF
- Moldovan time (EET or EEST) wherever you read a time, and today is Chisinau's day

## In progress

- The TVA12 return: the registers it is built from exist, the form does not yet
- Issuing invoices through e-Factura: a draft sent through Konta's e-Factura client was signed by the director on SFS's test portal and read back; issuing from Konta comes next
- Financial statements: the year-end closing exists, the forms and the mapping of accounts to their lines do not yet

## Not there yet

The IPC21 and VEN12 returns, the IVAO, IT Park and sole-trader (II) regimes, FIFO stock, long-term and foreign-currency loans.

## The founding offer

Whoever registers in the demo gets Konta free for six months from the day they register in the app after launch, with the same email address; for another address, write to us. From the demo's export, "Transfer from the demo" brings the company's details, partners, employees, fixed assets and opening balances into Konta.
